verdict.rationale: Extend ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.extend.ai) plus a docs MCP, both confirmed live in runtime probes, letting AI agents interact with the product using natural-language commands; docs also expose an 'Instructions for AI agents' section in llms.txt and a CLI for scripted/agentic use. Missing for 10: no hands-on transcript of an actual natural-language task being executed end-to-end through the MCP server (only handshake/auth confirmed) and no independent community report validating agentic natural-language usage.
